encoding.messages: Compact UTF-8 JSON, table/codec key order, no final LF; C0 escaped as lowercase \u00xx.
encoding.manifest: Metadata, not a wire message; pretty JSON with LF.
encoding.editors: Preserve no-final-LF in messages. No .editorconfig exists; .gitattributes text=auto eol=lf normalizes line endings but does not add a final LF. Byte validation is required.
encoding.invalid: JSON-shaped invalid messages use the same lexical convention; canonical does not imply schema validity. Explicit raw cases opt out.
encoding.numbers: Contract wire-conventions-and-bounds: binary64 shortest-round-trip significand, closest/even tie, exponent expanded, integral fraction omitted, signed zero 0.

interpretation: Each message file is a complete standalone shape witness, not an ordered engine transition or a claim of native acceptance. Context is fixture metadata, never wire data. Ordered scenario oracles are listed separately in scenarios.

expectations.valid-wire: Schema/encoding witness, not a promise of a particular state transition.
expectations.accepted-with-field-diagnostics: Settings envelope accepted with per-field last-good/default fallback.
expectations.accepted-held-row: Invalid identifiable row held narrowly with RowDiagnostic (unreadable, invalid-fact or conflicting-fact as applicable); no implicit closure or authority.
expectations.reject-wire: Invalid envelope, union, field, correlation or output shape; no applicable message authority.

scenarioFormat.initialization: Start a fresh engine and empty connection/adapter/renderer/storage models for every scenario; never inject retained core state. generationSequence is the deterministic generation-mint test source. initial.native describes a fake native world, not core state.
scenarioFormat.binding: The model adapter observes core handshake/settings traffic to bind authenticated capabilities, adapter and generation. Core report replies are not automatically applied: only explicit to=adapter inputs apply native mechanics. Pure-core output.actions is always empty.
scenarioFormat.wireInput: input.kind=wire sends the complete input.message with canonical encoding, or input.file bytes verbatim; relative files resolve from the scenario directory. to=core invokes the protocol/engine; to=adapter applies an exact published core decision without recomputing policy.
scenarioFormat.eventInput: fixture-event is an exact non-wire input to the named deterministic model, not protocol data. It changes only the declared native/capture/transport/render/storage condition. No elapsed-time completion is inferred. A prepare-request event stages that complete report as the pending transport correlation only; it does not run core policy or overwrite native facts. The deliberately incomplete empty inventory is not a claim of native absence.
scenarioFormat.oracle: Evaluate every expect.assertions jq expression against {output,history}, require boolean true. history maps completed step ids to their outputs. A core output exposes message (decoded response), bytes (exact response UTF-8 text), actions (empty at the pure-core boundary). Each model output exposes actions for this step only, native (current fake state), render (border/underlay descriptors, border including derived outer), storage (slots), retained (latest desired reply), lastWrites ([{win,write:LastWrite}]) and focusFeedback (FocusFeedback[]) emitted this step. These wrappers are fixture-only; ordinary reports carry LastWrite inside WindowFact. All assertion metadata stays outside the wire.
scenarioFormat.gates: settled steps must pass; OPEN/TBD steps are executed/recorded without an invented outcome, reported pending rather than passed. A scenario with pending steps is not full acceptance.
scenarioFormat.modelTrace: actions are ordered records with kind,win plus actual native arguments when applicable: persist-preimage,show,hide,focus,frame,state,restore. Models dispatch synchronously until a native callback is explicitly held/released; no timer/poll is allowed. Every native invalidation advances obs synchronously. lastWrites/focusFeedback are raw evidence, never injected settlement verdicts.
scenarioFormat.nativeEvents: outside-change applies only supplied window fields and foreground, replacing refusals/callbacks only when present; obs is the exact new invalidation watermark. A refusal is an unchanged readable native pre/post. Held callbacks keep an already issued action pending until release-callback supplies its native result. late-write-evidence reports the original raw property write without changing native state or latest desired targets. Default mechanical gates are readable, identity/tag matched and supported unless initial.native or an event says otherwise. In native-free domains fake windows have observed out/frame only, never a logical ws getter; arrival output arms sample these between lifetime/visibility reads. Core alone retains and compares logical home against the frozen target.
scenarioFormat.rendererEvents: frame-event joins the given native subject/frame/foreground/lifetime evidence to the accepted anchor through its causal chain; it never invents a new descriptor. foreground-event invalidates eligibility immediately. Keep underlay absolute or hide it; never translate it with the border anchor.
scenarioFormat.storageEvents: recoverable-hide exercises an already authorized hide with the supplied live native preimage and lifetime tag, persisting before mutation only if slotWritable. restart-and-restore checks the named lifetime tag before restoring and clearing only its owned slot. These are storage-unit inputs, not new adapter policy commands or protocol verbs. recoverable-state is the same storage-unit boundary for a supplied already-authorized StateTarget (not an automatic-float eligibility decision); property=above persists both keepAbove and keepBelow before the native state action, and restart-and-restore restores only the matching owned preimage. Failed slot storage authorizes no state action.
scenarioFormat.selectionEvents: resolve-action-context exercises the existing core selection rule on the complete listed cases independently of window admission; selected is the ordered result list. It is fixture-only access to core computation, not a product query message.
scenarioFormat.connectionEvents: disconnect destroys connection correlations, core lifetime state and model grants without replay; the next handshake consumes the next generationSequence value. deliver-stale-reply supplies a complete delayed reply after the declared newer binding/watermark, which must authorize no native action.
scenarioFormat.scope: Core-only, adapter-model and renderer/storage-model legs are deterministic offline tests. Platform-probe events are explicit unresolved evidence gates; fixture success cannot establish native API availability or paint/recovery smoothness. Executable identities are synthetic. Identity-dependent core cases preserve existing predicates; normalization mechanics and native producer acceptance remain separate.

K5 OPEN: prove the KDE adapter-local capture-to-native-source and eligibility join during the phase-2 port, including accepted-anchor motion without a round trip; extend FrameWitness only if that join cannot be proven. Other-host native joins still require their reviews.
Phase 0b must establish native primary/identity readability and truthful connector fallback. No reconnect tie-break is invented for unreadable/duplicate connectors.
The chain is settled, but 0b raw output-affinity readability must establish a truthful unhomed subject that is controllable/admissible for this route; do not invent a successful move.
Phase 0b must prove native slot survival and exact live-lifetime ownership, including any real logical-membership restoration found by the audit. Fake storage is not that evidence.
Windows app-owned exit remains refused until each approved baseline case is accepted; do not turn fullscreenExitable into assumed baseline acceptance.
G2: exact native-removal mechanisms and consumers await phase 0b. exist:false remains eligibility; no new removal capability or successful removal is assumed.
Phase 0b must establish truthful created-id correlation under competing external creation. Unknown/multiple candidates hold without recreation; no platform notification join is invented.
